appName: VR Travel Venice Carnival Streets Part 1
displayName: VR Travel Venice Carnival Streets Part 1
display_name: VR Travel Venice Carnival Streets Part 1
display_long_description:
VR Travel Venice Carnival Streets takes you on a unique walk through Venice. Sam arrived a few days before Dart and has already become somewhat familiar with the city. But for Dart, it’s his first time. He is captivated by the narrow alleys, historic buildings, and the vibrant energy of the Carnival. From the idyllic starting point near the Bridge of Sighs, your tour begins through the lively streets of Venice.

Together, you cross the famous St. Mark’s Square, where tourists and Carnival visitors mingle. The city’s sounds, the hum of voices, and street performers immediately draw Dart in. You weave through the small streets, past shop windows filled with Venetian masks, souvenirs, and artisan crafts. There is so much to see, and Dart can barely take his eyes off the colorful surroundings.

On the way to the Rialto Bridge, you experience the full spectacle of the Carnival – from magnificent costumes to traditional market vendors. While Sam enjoys finding the perfect route, Dart can hardly believe how lively and unique Venice is. The Rialto Bridge is your destination, but for Sam, the journey isn’t over yet: he is eager to take Dart on a gondola ride along the Grand Canal – but that awaits you in the next VR experience.

This app is part of a growing collection of Venice Carnival experiences with Sam and Dart. Each journey lets you discover a new side of the city, bringing the magic of Venice to life in an unforgettable way.

#venice #carnival #travel #italy #tourist
